name: Hugh Glass Lakeside Use Area
note: Small GFP camping loop on the south shore of Shadehill Reservoir off Hugh Glass Rd, about 3 km south of Shadehill Recreation Area, run from the Shadehill office: 16 back-in sites with no hookups in a planted shelterbelt, with a boat ramp and dock. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ARSD 41:03:04:03 (sdlegislature.gov/api/Rules/41:03:04:03.html, read 2026-11-22): '(3) Basic campground fee, sixteen dollars, at ... Hugh Glass Lakeside Use Area' -> a designated GFP fee campground under ARSD 41:03:01:15; Go Outdoors SD engine FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=21 ('Hugh Glass Lakeside Use Area'; sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22): 16 units 01-16, all 'Back-In Campsite Nonelectric', ReservableOnline true, UnitBasePrice $16, MaxEquipLength 55-70 ft, width 12 ft, one loop (LoopID 175) at 45.7363-45.7375,-102.2398--102.2420; engine amenities: Campsites, Campground(s), Vault Toilets (open year-round), Boat Ramp(s), Dock, Picnic Table(s), Group Picnic Shelter(s), ADA features; contact 'Hugh Glass Rd. Shadehill, SD 57638 605.374.5114' (the Shadehill office); GFP Shadehill page (read 2026-11-22) names 'Hugh Glass Lakeside Use Area' in its July 31, 2026 burn-ban notice. Esri imagery (rendered 2026-11-22) shows the gravel loop with what look like parked RVs at sites 11-13. GFP's web Lakeside Use Areas table (gfp.sd.gov/lakeside-use-areas/, read 2026-11-22) lists 'Hugh Glass at 14 S of Lemmon off SD 73' with no Camping mark, but that column is incomplete: it also leaves unmarked Bear Butte, Elm Creek, Little Bend, Minneconjou, Bailey and Dude Ranch, all of which ARSD 41:03:04:03 names as fee campgrounds. Public (state): no price gate or presence rule. Not in RV Life (Algolia, 5 km around the pin, 2026-11-22: only Shadehill RA).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World Imagery z16/z17/z18 frames at 45.7369,-102.2409 and 45.7358,-102.2418 with the engine's 16 site coordinates overlaid (all rendered). The loop sits on a bench above the south shore of Shadehill Reservoir: Open-Meteo DEM ~712-713 m at the sites vs ~689-692 m at the shore. The nearest water's edge is ~80-110 m from the SW-side sites (15/16 ~80-90 m, 12 ~105 m, 8/9 ~120 m), across the campground's own loop road and an open grass slope that drops ~20 m to a vegetated shoreline: not lakefront (loop road, distance over ~50 m, bench). The loop is planted with shelterbelt rows, but on the SW side sites 11-12 have only scattered shrubs between the pad, the loop road and the open grass, so the reservoir lies in open view below them -> lakeview for the SW-edge sites; the NE-side sites (1-7) look into the shelterbelt. Not a below-the-dam case: the pads sit ~20 m above the reservoir surface on its own shore.

fees.note: GFP basic campground fee; no electric sites.

curation_note: SD lead 2 (found p3-569 at 5725 Shadehill RA; vetted 2026-11-22). Kept although GFP's web Lakeside Use Areas table leaves its Camping column blank: the fee rule ARSD 41:03:04:03 names it a basic fee campground and the GFP engine sells 16 sites online. Pin is the centroid of the engine's 16 site coordinates. --Claude
flags: LUA table conflict: the lead brief says an unmarked LUA is a skip, but GFP's web table is incomplete (Bear Butte, Elm Creek, Little Bend, Minneconjou, Bailey and Dude Ranch are also unmarked there, yet ARSD 41:03:04:03 lists all of them as $16 fee campgrounds). Hugh Glass is in that ARSD list AND has 16 reservable sites on the GFP engine (facID 21). Added on those two sources; AWH may weigh the table.

Not a duplicate: nearest DB entries are 5725 Shadehill Recreation Area (45.7650,-102.2340, 3.2 km N, own campground on facID 58) and 5744 Llewellyn Johns RA (6.3 km NE, facID 36). Nothing named Hugh Glass in campgrounds.json.

Booking not written (no standing minimum found): the engine marks all 16 units ReservableOnline; ARSD 41:03:01:15 sets the 14-night limit. The SD state policy row should cover platform/window if a policy_ref is set.

Season unpublished: no GFP page for Hugh Glass (gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/hugh-glass-lakeside-use-area/ falls back to the park finder); engine lists the vault toilets as open year-round. Season left absent.
Lakeview rests on imagery only (no site photos on the engine, no reviews on its review page, 2026-11-22); downgrade to not waterfront if a reviewer reads the shelterbelt as a screen.
Access is Hugh Glass Rd (gravel per imagery); GFP posts no road or rig warning. No horse or OHV wording.
